coordinate_system: +Y up; +Z front; +X object right. Angles use local joint axes.
notes: 主轮绕水平轮轴旋转；每个吊舱独立反向补偿，始终朝上。示意角度，不表示完整循环只转67.5°。

states.name: 停止·灯灭
states.visual_description: Wheel at initial angle 0 degrees, all lamps off.

states.name: 旋转22.5°·暖灯
states.visual_description: Wheel rotated 22.5 degrees in its own vertical plane, warm amber rim and hub lights.

states.name: 旋转45°·青色追光A
states.visual_description: Wheel rotated 45 degrees, alternating short cyan and unlit rim-light segments, warm hub.

states.name: 旋转67.5°·彩色追光B
states.visual_description: Wheel rotated 67.5 degrees, alternating peach and pale cyan rim lights, shifted chase pattern.

generation_policy: 生成3D使用baseline中性造型，动态状态仅用于灯光/关节/形变设定；不对各状态分别生成模型。
reference_accuracy: AI概念关键帧；角度与关节约束以参数为准，不是同一3D网格的精确渲染。
clip_preview: 目录页的关键帧轮播，不是骨骼动画或物理动画。

rotation_loop.note: 四张图是角度采样，不是一个完整旋转周期的四等分。

constraints: 轮体绕垂直轮盘的水平轴旋转
吊舱独立绕轮轴方向反向补偿，保持世界朝上
灯光相位独立于旋转相位
